description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of various model configurations across different probing tasks, with the vertical axis labeled “Accuracy” and scaled linearly from 70 to 95, and the horizontal axis listing the model configurations. The configurations are grouped into two main categories: “1st layer,” “random layers,” and its variants (“+B₂,” “+L₂,” “+R₂,” “+permute”), “random,” and its variants, and “unperturbed.” The “1st layer” configuration consists of two bars: a light blue bar at approximately 80 accuracy and a darker blue bar at approximately 82 accuracy. The “random layers” group includes six bars: a light green bar at approximately 79.5 accuracy, followed by five darker green bars each at approximately 81.5 accuracy. The “random” group contains five bars: a light pink bar at approximately 71.5 accuracy and four darker red bars each at approximately 73.5 accuracy. The final bar, labeled “unperturbed,” is orange and reaches approximately 91 accuracy. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order of the model configurations listed on the x-axis, with the “unperturbed” bar visually emphasized by its height and distinct color. The chart includes a grey bar on the far left, which is not labeled and does not correspond to any configuration on the x-axis.
